correctness.rationale: Exact uniform-history measure is 1/n!, excess recurrence is e_{t+1}=e_t+u_t+e_{u_t}. Fixing the first r indices freezes all feasible later positive selection increments j+e_j (j<=r), giving an exact binomial basis with nonnegative integers. At k=r,r-1 the adder equals Mahonian counts, while at k=r-2 their coefficient difference is r-2 due solely to early selection of index 1 at time 1, which changes the later cost of selecting 2 from 2 to 3. This proves M-A=(r-2)binom(n-r,r-2)+O_r(n^(r-3)) and limiting ratio r(r-1)(r-2). r=0,1,2 are handled separately or omitted from the correction assertion. Verified 164 exact finite checks using the packaged standard-library script, not as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Natural all-fixed-surplus left-tail probabilities for a history-dependent random addition process, with a constructive nonnegative integer coefficient formula and an exact second-order comparison to a canonical independent-digit permutation inversion law. The r-dependent r(r-1)(r-2) coefficient quantifies the first effect of feedback, beyond previously stated isolated endpoints or moment asymptotics. No unproved growing-surplus conclusion or downstream application is claimed.
